Convert between RLWE and CKKS ciphertexts

Source: R/schemelet.R
schemelet_convert_rlwe_to_ckks.Rd

schemelet_convert_rlwe_to_ckks() embeds an RLWE ciphertext modulo big_q into a CKKS ciphertext with slots slots at level, so that eval_fbt() can process it. schemelet_convert_ckks_to_rlwe() extracts an RLWE ciphertext modulo q from a CKKS ciphertext. Both ciphertexts are under the same secret key.

Usage

schemelet_convert_rlwe_to_ckks(cc, coeffs, pub_key, big_q, slots, level = 0L)

schemelet_convert_ckks_to_rlwe(ctxt, q)

Arguments

cc

A CKKS CryptoContext.

coeffs

A PolyVector; the RLWE ciphertext.

pub_key

The PublicKey, used for an encryption of zero that supplies the metadata of the CKKS ciphertext.

big_q

The modulus of the RLWE ciphertext: a string of decimal digits, or a whole number of at most 2^53.

slots

Integer; number of slots of the CKKS ciphertext.

level

Integer; level of the CKKS ciphertext. Default 0L.

ctxt

A CKKS Ciphertext with two elements.

q

The modulus of the RLWE ciphertext to produce, as for big_q.

Value

schemelet_convert_rlwe_to_ckks(): a Ciphertext. schemelet_convert_ckks_to_rlwe(): a PolyVector.

See also

schemelet_encrypt_coeff(), eval_fbt()
